_comment_: Example custom policy file for Cortex. Point POLICY_FILE at this
(or a copy) to override the built-in DEFAULT_POLICIES in policy.py.
Patterns are Python regular expressions matched against the literal
string the model passed as the tool's argv / cmd. DENY wins over ASK
_SYSTEM_DIRS_DENY) are re-expanded across every tool that consumes
them — add an entry once and every tool that reads files gets it.
